name: dsh-desktop
description: DeepSeek Harness 桌面工作台：Electron 原生壳（仅桌面原生能力）+ bridge 桥接插件

scripts.dist:win: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/make-icons.mjs && node scripts/setup-runtime.mjs && electron-builder --win nsis --config.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist
scripts.dist:win:portable: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/make-icons.mjs && node scripts/setup-runtime.mjs && electron-builder --win portable --config.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/make-icons.mjs && node scripts/setup-runtime.mjs && electron-builder --mac dmg
